d: Jharkhand men parv-tyoharon ko lekar bhaktimay mahaul bana huaa hai. rajy ke vibhinn hisson men govardhan puja, sohray aur kali puja ka aayojan shraddha aur ullas ke sath kiya ja raha hai. vahin, aagami chhath mahaparv ko lekar prashasan aur sthaniy star par taiyariyan tej hain tatha chhath ghaton ki saph-saphaee par vishesh jor diya ja raha hai. dusri or, rajy ki rajniti men bhi halchal tej hai. bhajpa neta babulal marandi ne khastahal vahnon ko vapas kar sarkar ki karyashaili par saval uthae hain. vahin, aajsu parti ne nisha bhagat ki maut ke mamle men nishpaksh janch sunishchit karne ke…
